summary: A drum synthesizer firmware that runs CLATTER's port of the Erica Synths LXR-02 sound engine on the FM-1, with a generative step sequencer. It is built on M-VAVE's fm1_open SDK and replaces the stock instrument.
features: LXR-02 drum engine: six voices, seven triggers, modulation and locks
64 steps on four pages, seven tracks, conditional steps
Generates kits and patterns by style; mutate a track or the whole pattern
16 kits; DRUM and chromatic PITCH keyboard modes
9 project slots; MIDI notes and clock over USB, USB audio
1.0.0 verified on one unit; many controls tested only in the emulator

headings: what it does on the fm-1 once installed
